response.overview: Set in 2004 at the strict St. Mark’s Catholic High School, The Body follows an elite, competitive all-girl dance troupe called "The Lions," ruled by co-captains Anya and Elise as they hide their mutual romantic feelings behind Catholic guilt and peer pressure. When an injury opens a spot on the team, pious newcomer Grace is welcomed in over awkward outsider Lisbeth, culminating in a Halloween night initiation ritual at an abandoned convent that goes dangerously wrong. Left comatose, Grace's sudden prophetic visions and seizures trigger a wave of mass hysteria across the town, blurring the line between religious fervor, adolescent obsession, and repressed desire.
response.tagline: They pray hard and sin harder.
response.title: The Body
